text:
```yaml
name: Infisical Testing

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  test-infisical-integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Build CLI
        run: npm run build

      - name: Run Infisical-specific tests
        run: npm test -- --testPathPattern=infisical

      - name: Verify AsyncAPI WebSocket Auth
        run: |
          # Verify that the assembly snapshot reflects auth: true for WebSocket channels
          if grep -q '"auth": true' packages/cli/src/ir/asyncapi/__tests__/snapshots/assembly.json; then
            echo "✅ WebSocket auth is correctly enabled in assembly snapshot"
          else
            echo "❌ WebSocket auth is not enabled in assembly snapshot"
            exit 1
          fi
```
